groups.sub: the packaging space less everything above

hypothesis.label: Inside
hypothesis.value: one cup per half: every part's room run to the split

hypothesis.label: Flange
hypothesis.value: 8 mm each side of the split: a sealing land 10 mm round the inside, the bolts' Ø20 bosses on it (the process's rules)

hypothesis.label: Bolts
hypothesis.value: 13, evenly round the inside at most 80 mm apart; the halves joined only there

layers.label: Gears
layers.note: tip Ø over the face width; the inside keeps the least clearances round them (8.25 mm at the tips, 3 mm at the sides)

layers.label: Shafts
layers.note: between the end faces; see-through where they leave: each seal's bore, and the half-shafts' joints beyond the output's ends

layers.label: Bearing bores
layers.note: each bearing's outside Ø over its width

layers.label: Mounts
layers.note: 3 bosses for the vehicle (assumed); see-through, the room of the vehicle's bracket and bolt beyond both faces, as far as the boss is long

layers.label: Packaging space
layers.note: the layout's envelope grown by the installation clearance, and the mounts

layers.label: Split flange
layers.note: where the halves meet, between the stages at z = 14.35 mm (the design's choice): the flange, a sealing land round the inside, a flange deep each side (the process's rules)

layers.label: Shell
layers.note: the inside (every part's room, run to the split: the parts go in from there) and its least wall, 4 mm

layers.label: Bolts
layers.note: 13 bolts where the halves meet, at most 80 mm apart round the inside (the process's rule)

layers.label: Design space
layers.note: the packaging space less every element: where the optimiser adds metal
